fields.name: account_sid
fields.help: Account SID of a Brand API access token (impact.com > user profile > Settings > Technical > API > Create Access Token); the HTTP Basic username and the {AccountSID} in every path.

fields.name: auth_token
fields.help: The token's Auth Token, the HTTP Basic password. Needs read scope for programs and reports.

config_fields.name: report_id
config_fields.help: Report handle for get_report, taken from GET /Advertisers/{AccountSID}/Reports (Id of a report with ApiAccessible=true, e.g. a performance-by-day report); its columns are listed by /Reports/{ReportId}/MetaData.

me.note: GET /Advertisers/{AccountSID}/CompanyInformation: the brand account's company details.

list_campaigns.note: GET /Advertisers/{AccountSID}/Campaigns: the account's programs (impact.com calls programs 'Campaigns'); status filters State (ACTIVE, AWAITING_REVIEW, CANCELLED, CLOSED, DEACTIVATED, DELINQUENT, REJECTED, SETUP, SETUP_COMPLETE). Programs carry no budget; Type (Performance, Retail Media, Creator …) is in raw. `account_id` is not sent (the Account SID selects the account); `page`/`limit` are not sent (only the first page is returned).

get_report.note: GET /Advertisers/{AccountSID}/Reports/{report_id}?StartDate&EndDate&SUBAID=<campaign_id> (Run a Report, synchronous legacy endpoint with pagination limits): the configured report's Records, with the report's own columns (see /Reports/{report_id}/MetaData) left as returned in each row's raw. campaign_id is the program id (SUBAID), 'required for most reports'. Needs the report_id config field. `account_id` is not sent.

not_offered.list_accounts: API tokens are per account: every path is /Advertisers/{AccountSID}/… and the Brand API has no account list (https://integrations.impact.com/brand-api-reference/readme/authentication).
not_offered.update_budget: impact.com programs are pay-per-action and have no budget attribute (Program schema, https://integrations.impact.com/brand-api-reference/reference/programs/programs).
not_offered.pause_resume: The Programs API is read-only (List All Programs, Get Program Details); program State cannot be changed through the Brand API (https://integrations.impact.com/brand-api-reference/reference/programs/programs).
